# Splitlings

> Splitlings is a free, single-player tap-to-split orb-defence arcade game that
> runs in any web browser. Tap glowing orbs to split them before they grow to
> supernova size, chain same-color splits for combo multipliers, manage your
> energy bar, and climb the global leaderboard.

## What it is
- Genre: arcade / action / casual, single-player.
- Platform: web browser (mobile-first, also desktop). No download or install.
- Price: free to play.
- Account: optional. Play instantly as a guest; sign in with a one-time email
  code only to save scores to the leaderboard.

## How to play
- Tap orbs to split them into smaller pieces.
- Same-colored orbs merge — the bigger orb eats the smaller one.
- Everything keeps growing; chain same-color splits for combo multipliers.
- Manage your energy bar wisely.
- Open the pause menu with the ≡ Menu button (top-right) or by tapping and
  holding anywhere.
- Don't let any orb reach supernova size, or the run ends.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://splitlings.com): overview and how-to-play.
- [Play](https://splitlings.com/game): launch the game in your browser.
- [Leaderboard](https://splitlings.com/leaderboard): top 50 all-time scores.
